why: Animal medicine markets of $20 to $113 million for pets, cattle and poultry are believable for a national market, and the growth paths are steady.
An office furniture maker with $310-470 million per range, about 15-20% of $1.8-2.6 billion markets, and 280-540 sales reps (roughly $0.7-1.5 million revenue each) is believable.
Language schools earning $6-21 million in fees each, with promotion budgets of $0.6-2.4 million (about 7-19% of fees), are high but possible for large schools.
Automatic car wash sites washing 150-550 cars a day, costing $800,000 and earning $2 profit per car are believable, since multi-bay or tunnel sites handle several cars at once.
A framing shop making 52 frames a month with half a framer (about 1.4 hours per frame) and 246 with 2.5 framers is consistent and believable.
A potato cost chain from $0.29 per kg at the farm to $0.91 at the fryer adds up correctly, and a 10% peeling loss is plausible.
Farms using 900,000 cubic metres a year at $0.14 (about $126,000 bills), 3,100 enquiries and the conversion and savings rates give a believable advisory business.
About 2.3-2.5 million bags a month fits a large international airport, and the automated sorting funnel narrows consistently from 100%.
Existing-store and new-store parts add to each category total (for example 1.0 + 0.3 = 1.3), and a total of 3.3 points of annual growth is believable for a supermarket chain.
A home-improvement chain with $57-206 million per category and margins of 3-29% is believable, paint's high margin being within range.
